null_generator.ORDER_SHUFFLE: Fisher-Yates over exact TRUE event objects using derived seed; reject identity permutation; preserve event_uid/payload/event_type/exposure; reindex position only
null_generator.REVERSE: exact reverse of TRUE event-object order; preserve event_uid/payload/event_type/exposure; reindex position only
null_generator.SOURCE_SWAP: preserve order/payload/event_type/exposure; replace source_id RatHub->ControlAgent; causal_origin=SOURCE_SWAP
null_generator.COMMON_DRIVER: preserve order/payload/event_type/exposure; replace source_id with SharedEnvironment; causal_origin=COMMON_DRIVER; no RatHub identifier in payload
null_generator.NULL: preserve order/payload/event_type/exposure; replace source_id with NeutralAgent; causal_origin=NULL; no RatHub identifier in payload

sever_audit.qualification_scope: auditor detector only; does not establish real-system causal isolation
sever_audit.pass_rule: clean synthetic trace passes and every single injected forbidden channel is detected

secondary_excluded_from_primary.reason: semantic label overlaps Interaction event BOUNDARY

probe_manifest.contamination_rule: probe payload_id must be absent from all Interaction payload_id values

primary_metric.name: delta_rhd
primary_metric.sample_estimator: 2*mean_cross_distance - mean_within_X - mean_within_Y, including diagonal zero terms

seed_policy.derivation: sha256(root_seed|namespace) first 8 bytes as unsigned integer
seed_policy.seed_activation: at least two distinct ORDER_SHUFFLE digests across qualification roots

qualification_decision_rules.Q2_KNOWN_HISTORY_POSITIVE_CONTROL: fixed +0.20 shift on trust_to_C and affinity_to_C yields distance>=0.02
qualification_decision_rules.Q3_SEVER_LEAKAGE_AUDIT: synthetic detector qualification PASS only; real-system SEVER_PASS remains unavailable
qualification_decision_rules.Q4_EVENT_COUNT_MATCHING: all generated worlds have exactly 100 events
qualification_decision_rules.Q5_CONTENT_FREQUENCY_MATCHING: payload multiset, event_type frequency, and total exposure exactly equal TRUE
qualification_decision_rules.Q6_UNSEEN_PROBE_CONTAMINATION: all primary probe payload_ids disjoint from Interaction payload_ids
qualification_decision_rules.Q7_METRIC_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION: Q1 and Q2 both PASS and metric is finite/nonnegative
qualification_decision_rules.Q8_SEED_REPRODUCIBILITY_PILOT: all qualification roots replay byte-identically and seed activation PASS
qualification_decision_rules.Q10_LOGGING_COMPLETENESS: synthetic records satisfy all required fields and [0,1] primary domains
